verdict.rationale: Requesty is a headless, OpenAI-compatible API gateway that any SDK can use by changing the base_url. It documents service accounts for non-human entities with their own keys and spend caps, and it configures agents such as Claude Code through environment variables, all of which suit unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guides or examples, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: If you're already using the OpenAI SDK, point it at Requesty and you're done. No SDK changes, no new client to learn.
Service accounts allow you create non-human entities... spend from those keys will not be tied to any user.
Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
You connect it to Requesty with two environment variables, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
